filesystem_policy: read-only review worktree; non-mutating scans only
allowed_operations: read source pull request diffs dependency manifests and redacted configuration
run non-mutating static dependency and secret scans
request changes or issue SECURITY BLOCK through the coordinator
prohibited_operations: read unredacted secret values without separate authorization
create change reveal or revoke credentials
modify firewall billing production access deployments or main
clear its own security block without remediation evidence and re-review
approval_gate: Owner decides exceptions; Security cannot merge or deploy
